title: Review runtime report producer text
changes: Review gameplay, issue, comparison and graphics report producers for English-first authored text. Clarify 16 human-readable descriptions and diagnostics while retaining machine identifiers and report schemas.
Document that longer gameplay event descriptions count against the existing event-byte cap; previously saved reports remain unchanged.
validation: Rustfmt parsed all four producer files as Rust 2021. Byte-for-byte comparison after exactly 16 expected string substitutions confirms the rest of the three modified sources is unchanged; the comparison producer is byte-identical. Whitespace check passes.
limitations: Static language and syntax validation only; no builds, report generation, ROM or runtime/platform tests repeated. Event metadata length can change how many records fit under the unchanged byte cap. Other producers, helper/test modules, dynamic inputs and both source trees remain under audit.
